subject: Urgent: Rapid Sentinel Hotfix — Immediate Canary & Smoke Test Request
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@orchardai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Rapid Sentinel Hotfix — Immediate Canary & Smoke Test Request

Hi Maya —

We discovered a rare sentinel interaction in the 2.1.4 runtime path that can cause degraded inference for long-conversation chat sessions (~>8k tokens) under a specific KV-cache alignment. We pushed a minimal hotfix (sentinel_fix_patch.diff) this morning that addresses the alignment check and prevents the degraded path from being taken.

Because this is an unscheduled, short-notice change, we want to run a targeted canary for Orchard AI’s production traffic and ask your team to run a one-minute smoke test on 2 of the tenant endpoints we’ll route to the canary pool. Expected impact: no downtime; a small number of requests will be routed to canary GPUs for ~15 minutes.

Can you confirm an engineer is available to run the smoke test at 09:00 PT? We’ll provide the canary hostnames and a curl snippet.

What we need from you:
- Confirmation to proceed at 09:00 PT
- Run the two smoke tests below and paste the first 8 lines of output into the thread

Curl snippets (example):
1) curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d "{"input":"hello"}" https://canary-us-west.redwood.com/v1/generate?tenant=orchard-prod-1
2) curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d "{"input":"status"}" https://canary-us-west.redwood.com/v1/status?tenant=orchard-prod-1

Attachments: sentinel_fix_patch.diff (patch), a short smoke harness we used (canary-smoke-results-20280602.txt).

I’ll be on call for escalation if anything unexpected shows up.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Sr. Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Patel <maya@orchardai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: orchard-support@orchardai.com
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Rapid Sentinel Hotfix — Immediate Canary & Smoke Test Request

Thanks Diego —

We can do 09:00 PT. I’ve looped in our on-call (orchard-support) and our infra lead Ben is standing by. Will run the two curl checks and report back. Please send the exact canary hostnames and any headers we should be using other than Authorization.

—Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Platform, Orchard AI

Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Rapid Sentinel Hotfix — Immediate Canary & Smoke Test Request

Maya —

Canary hostnames:
- canary-us-west-1a.redwood.com (routes to GPU pool C)
- canary-us-west-1b.redwood.com (routes to GPU pool D)

Use header X-Redwood-Canary: orchard-20280602 and X-Request-Trace to tag the traffic.
Expected footprint: ~0.3% of steady requests while we validate. We’ll monitor telemetry and revert the route if latency or error rate exceeds thresholds.

If you paste the first lines of the status output we’ll confirm the runtime is returning the corrected path.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Ben Gutierrez <orchard-support@orchardai.com>, Maya Patel <maya@orchardai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Rapid Sentinel Hotfix — Immediate Canary & Smoke Test Request

Thanks Ben — this is exactly what we wanted to see. A couple quick follow-ups: 

- Can you also capture a single failing case (if it occurs) and forward the raw request_id and the small trace we asked for? That will let us validate the patch end-to-end.
- We’ll keep the canary running for 45 minutes and then promote the patch to the wider pool if telemetry stays green (error rate <0.2% and p95 latency delta <15ms).
- If at any time you see increased errors, set X-Redwood-Canary: orchard-rollback and we’ll immediately drain and revert routing.

Postmortem follow-up: we’ll open INF-4921 with the full timeline and mitigations, and I’ll schedule a short postmortem with Orchard and our oncall rotation tomorrow to review root cause and longer-term fixes.

Attachment: canary-smoke-results-20280602.txt (short harness log)

Appreciate the quick coordination — we know short-notice maint can be annoying.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Sr. Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
